description: Context baseline with no added safety margin.

asi.hypothesis: The existing estimator is the control; measure asymmetric underestimation loss before changing production behavior.
asi.checks: executor context tests and typecheck passed

asi.hypothesis: A small fixed margin should reduce provider-serialization underestimation without changing the estimator shape.
asi.result: Primary and holdout loss improved; holdout threshold misses reached zero.

description: Increase the fixed estimate margin to 256 tokens.

asi.hypothesis: A larger margin may remove more residual underestimation while keeping early-compaction mistakes bounded.
asi.result: Primary loss improved again and holdout threshold misses stayed at zero; three training threshold false positives were observed.

description: Increase the fixed estimate margin to 384 tokens.

asi.hypothesis: 384 tokens may cover the remaining request-shape residual at the stock threshold.
asi.result: Best optimization score among accepted safety candidates, zero threshold misses on both splits, and three training false positives.

description: Increase the fixed estimate margin to 512 tokens.

asi.hypothesis: A larger margin could further reduce underestimation.
asi.rollback_reason: It exceeded the three false-positive safety cap and was worse than 384 on the optimization split.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep 384 and validate it in the full executor and integration suites.

description: Admission baseline against the frozen synthetic corpus.

asi.hypothesis: The existing classifier should establish the policy error profile before changing regexes.
asi.result: One hyphenated substantial-work false negative and one direct negation false positive.

description: Cover hyphenated multiple-concerns work and changing/modifying/editing/writing negation forms.

asi.hypothesis: Normalize the two observed lexical edge cases without broadening the substantial-work policy.
asi.result: Zero optimization and holdout errors; focused admission tests and typecheck passed.

description: Stock-Pi composition baseline with an Autoresearch-shaped extension follow-up.

asi.hypothesis: The existing extension-source guard should prevent an Autoresearch follow-up from entering automatic Prewalk assessment.
asi.result: Real agent-loop characterization passed with one provider turn and no prewalk_assess entry.

description: Remove the extension-source guard as a composition candidate.

asi.hypothesis: Allowing extension-sourced messages into automatic admission might simplify composition.
asi.rollback_reason: The integration test immediately admitted the Autoresearch-shaped follow-up and persisted prewalk_assess.
asi.next_action_hint: Restore the fail-closed guard; do not move composition policy into host correlation.

description: Tool-driven baseline confirming the accepted 384-token context-estimate margin.

asi.hypothesis: The accepted 384-token margin will reproduce the frozen optimization and holdout scores with zero threshold false negatives under the actual Autoresearch runner.
asi.result: The exact frozen metrics reproduced and all backpressure checks passed.

description: Context candidate with no added safety margin; reproduced the expected worse score and failed the exact-margin regression tests.

asi.hypothesis: Removing the margin would show whether the accepted calibration still beats the stock estimator under the active runner.
asi.rollback_reason: The candidate worsened the primary and holdout scores and failed the focused tests because the expected 384-token safety behavior disappeared.
asi.next_action_hint: Let log_experiment restore the 384-token baseline, then test the 128-token candidate.

description: Context candidate with a 128-token safety margin; it improved on zero margin but remained worse than the accepted 384-token baseline and failed the exact-margin regression tests.

asi.hypothesis: A 128-token margin might preserve most of the safety improvement at lower early-compaction cost.
asi.rollback_reason: The candidate's optimization and holdout scores were both worse than 384, and the exact-margin checks rejected the candidate.
asi.next_action_hint: Let Autoresearch restore 384, then test 256 tokens.

description: Context candidate with a 256-token safety margin; it improved over smaller margins but remained worse than 384 and failed the exact-margin regression tests.

asi.hypothesis: A 256-token margin might approach the accepted loss while avoiding unnecessary early compaction.
asi.rollback_reason: The candidate remained worse on both optimization and holdout scores and failed the focused tests that pin the accepted 384-token behavior.
asi.next_action_hint: Let Autoresearch restore 384, then test 512 tokens for the safety-cap tradeoff.

description: Context candidate with a 512-token safety margin; it reduced underestimation but exceeded the false-positive safety cap, was worse than 384 on optimization, and failed exact-margin tests.

asi.hypothesis: A 512-token margin might reduce underestimation enough to justify its early-compaction cost.
asi.rollback_reason: The candidate had five optimization threshold false positives against a cap of three, a worse primary score than 384, and failed the exact-margin tests.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the restored 384-token margin and move to the admission segment.
